programCreation.headline: CREATE PROGRAMS THAT SHOW OFF THE REAL YOU
programCreation.description: Our top of the line in-house tools are like nothing else on the market, allowing you complete flexibility and ease of use to create tailored programs for your clients in an efficient time frame.
programCreation.toolsHeader: Our tools include but are not limited to:

tools.item1: An extensive library of exercises that you can use or duplicate to create your own custom ones. Save these custom exercises for private use, or share them with other PTs.
tools.item2: A program creator that allows you to set metrics and create customized workout schedules unbound by conventional week cycles.
tools.item3: Add assisting text documents to reply to your clients outside your working hours using an AI interpreter.
tools.item4: Set up your own custom pricing model and create discount codes to share with your followers at a fingers touch.

about.description:
In an era where fitness information is everywhere, navigating the noise has never been harder. While science-backed knowledge is more accessible than ever, social media has also given rise to self-proclaimed "experts" who mislead people with flashy trends and empty promises—draining their time, money, and sometimes even harming their health.

That’s why we created Rafik. We believe that everyone deserves access to reliable fitness expertise—guidance that is not only effective but also ethical and sustainable. However, we also understand the challenges: in-person coaching can be expensive, and finding the right online trainer can feel like a gamble. Rafik eliminates the guesswork by connecting you with the right trainer while ensuring accountability at every step.

And to the trainers—we’ve got your back, too! By sharing your verified programs on our platform, you gain access to a serious and dedicated audience who genuinely wants to transform their lives. Rafik helps you manage, track, and grow your client base while ensuring your hard work gets the recognition it deserves through a fair and transparent review system.

Rafik is our gift to the fitness community—we hope you enjoy it!
about.visionDescription: To empower individuals in the MENA to achieve their fitness goals with confidence and accountability, by providing personalized and reliable connections to expert trainers at affordable prices.
about.missionDescription: At Rafik, we connect people to fitness professionals who truly understand their needs, ensuring a tailored journey with measurable results. Through a platform built on trust, expertise, and accountability, we aim to foster a supportive community where everyone can reach their full potential, no matter their starting point.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy for Rafik Fitness Squire

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to Rafik Fitness Squire! Your privacy is important to us, and we are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our app.

informationCollected.title: 2. Information We Collect
items: Account Information: Name, email address, and password.
Profile Information: Users are required to upload a profile photo.
Health and Fitness Data: Data entered about workouts, diet, weight, and health metrics.
Device and Usage Data: Technical information like IP address, device type, and usage patterns.

howWeUse.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
items: To provide, maintain, and improve our app’s features.
To personalize your fitness experience and track progress.
To communicate updates, features, and support inquiries.
To ensure security and prevent unauthorized access.

dataSharing.title: 4. Data Sharing and Disclosure
items: Service Providers: Trusted third-party services assisting with app functionality.
Legal Requirements: Compliance with legal obligations when necessary.

dataSecurity.title: 5. Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement security measures to protect your data. However, no method is completely secure, so we encourage safeguarding account credentials.

yourRights.title: 6. Your Rights and Choices
items: Access, update, or delete account information.
Adjust app settings for profile visibility.

dataRetention.title: 7. Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain data as necessary for service provision or as required by law. Deleted accounts result in permanent data removal, except where retention is legally required.

childrensPrivacy.title: 8. Children’s Privacy
childrensPrivacy.content: Rafik Fitness Squire is not intended for children under 13. If data from a child is discovered, we will take steps to remove it.

policyChanges.title: 9. Changes to This Privacy Policy
policyChanges.content: We may update this policy periodically. Continued use of the app after updates constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

contactUs.title: 10. Contact Us
contactUs.content: If you have any questions, contact us at [Insert Contact Email].

accountDeletion.title: 11. Request Account & Data Deletion
accountDeletion.content: If you wish to delete your account and associated data, please visit rafikapp.ae/delete-account. Once your request is submitted, your data will be permanently removed, except where retention is legally required.

deleteAccount.description: Fill in your details below to request the deletion of your account and associated data.
